concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-cash-app-pay-web-drop-in]] — 2026-09-15-captured Cash App Pay Web Drop-in Sessions/Advanced guide covering amount configuration, tokenization, stored payments, $cashtag retrieval, and test/live setup; source flags a tokenization example omission and consent boundary.
warnings: Cash App Pay is distinct from Cash App Afterpay.
The Sessions v70+ tokenization text calls for shopperReference, but its example omits that field.
Automatic storage configuration does not prove explicit shopper permission; the source strongly recommends permission for future recurring/card-on-file use.
